## Coordinating action
Request, propose and negotiate shared or individual action.
Boundary: Require a successful request, proposal, commitment or response about action. Merely describing a desire or future event is insufficient.

Assess requests, offers or invitations, suggestions, commitments, acceptance or refusal, and negotiation. ช่วยย้ายกล่องนี้ไปที่ประตูหน่อย requests help; เดี๋ยวฉันถือกระเป๋าให้ offers to carry a bag. พักกันสักครู่ไหม proposes a shared break. พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะเอาเครื่องมือมา can undertake a task in planning, but future marking alone does not establish commitment. วันนี้ไปไม่ได้ can decline an invitation and a proposed Saturday meeting can negotiate an alternative. ได้ can accept a prior concrete proposal contextually. A copied หน่อย without a recoverable request is absent. Politeness depends on reference terms, particles and social context; absence of ครับ or ค่ะ is not automatically failed coordination. Determine who is to act and what response is sought, preserving natural omissions and distinguishing permission questions from requests that the listener perform an action.

Self-reference terms such as ฉัน and ผม have social uses, and other reference strategies can be natural. Evaluate the stance-bearing construction rather than imposing one pronoun or sentence-final particle on all speakers.

## Information exchange
Seek, supply and verify information relevant to the exchange.
Boundary: Require successful information seeking or a relevant informative response. Question-shaped requests for action do not qualify just for their form.

Look for information questions, relevant answers, factual checking and useful detail. ร้านปิดกี่โมง asks a closing time; ห้าโมงเย็น answers it contextually with an afternoon hour. ร้านปิดห้าโมงเย็นใช่ไหม checks a proposed fact. Content questions do not require English auxiliary inversion. A ได้ไหม question can request an action rather than simply ask about capability. ทางเข้าอยู่ทางด้านลาน supplies a useful entrance location when the listener needs it. A copied ไหม with no recoverable proposition is absent. Repeating the relevant predicate can answer yes/no questions naturally; do not require ใช่ in every positive answer. พูดอีกครั้งได้ไหม requests repetition and addresses the exchange itself. Respect short answers and recoverable omissions, but do not invent context that would make an otherwise ambiguous fragment relevant. Additional length alone does not establish useful detail.

Locate events in time and express their temporal structure.
